t: This is a spot tied to The Real World: London, the fourth season of MTV's reality series, in which a group of diverse strangers lived together for several months while cameras followed their lives and relationships. It's the only season of the show ever filmed in the United Kingdom. The series was co-created by Mary-Ellis Bunim, an American television producer who also co-created Road Rules. So London's turn is one chapter in a format she helped build, which sent strangers to a new city each season.
